text:
alice (Platform PM): quick sync request — we need one canonical view for per-pool headroom that covers Hosted + Dedicated so routing + rollouts can use it. key signals: sm occupancy, GPU memory pct, queue depth, pending inflight, and reserved/committed quota by tenant. any blockers on telemetry or naming?

ben (Runtime Eng): we already emit: sm_occupancy_ratio, sm_mem_bytes_used, sm_mem_bytes_total, queue_depth{pool_id}. we do NOT emit per-tenant reserved_quota — that lives in quota-service. also pool_id labels exist but can be noisy across regions.

carla (Console): from the console side we want: 1) pool heatmap (occupancy pct), 2) per-pool timeline of memory pct, 3) queue depth + tail latency correlate, 4) a per-tenant overlay (when available) and a filter to switch hosted vs dedicated. UX: downsample for 1h/6h but keep raw for 5m. needs stable pool_id and human name.

dave (SRE): alerting note — we should separate pager-worthy from proactive. e.g. headroom_pct < 10% for 5m -> page only for hosted pools with customer impact OR dedicated pools if customer SLA impacted. For capacity-signal: headroom_pct < 30% -> warn in slack channel.

ben (Runtime Eng): quick question: how do we define headroom precisely? several teams use different formulas.

alice (Platform PM): proposal: headroom_pct = (available_slots / total_slots) * 100. available_slots = total_slots - max(current_running_slots, committed_slots). For Hosted committed_slots = 0; for Dedicated committed_slots = value from quota-service tag (committed_capacity). This keeps it simple for routing decisions.

carla (Console): that works. sample prom queries I'd use in the dashboard:

```
# occupancy pct per pool (instant)
sm_occupancy_ratio{pool_id=~"~"} * 100

# memory pct per pool (5m avg)
(sum by(pool_id) (rate(sm_mem_bytes_used[5m]))) / (sum by(pool_id) (sm_mem_bytes_total)) * 100

# queue depth (current)
queue_depth{pool_id="POOL-123"}

# headroom estimate (requires exported committed_slots gauge)
(total_slots{pool_id} - max(sm_running_slots{pool_id}, committed_slots{pool_id})) / total_slots{pool_id} * 100
```

ben (Runtime Eng): implementing `committed_slots{pool_id, tenant_id}` as a gauge from quota-service sidecar is doable. two implementation options: 1) quota-service pushes to metrics exporter with labels, 2) runtime scrapes an API endpoint and joins by pool_id. I prefer push from quota-service to avoid coupling runtime to quota infra.

dave (SRE): push is fine. just make sure tenant_id labeling is optional to avoid cardinality explosion on large hosted pools. maybe only expose tenant_id for dedicated pools / high-commit tenants.

carla (Console): agreed on cardinality. Console will treat tenant_id label as optional and only show per-tenant rows when present. For the heatmap fallback we only need pool-level metrics. Also add metadata mapping: pool_id -> region, deployment_type (hosted|dedicated), human_name.

infra-bot: dashboard template PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-dashboards/pull/1234 — includes heatmap + per-pool detail + alert rules draft.

ben (Runtime Eng): I'll add the committed_slots gauge and stable pool_name label. ETA: 7 days for metric + 2 days for test harness.

alice (Platform PM): plan: Ben adds metric; quota-service team to push committed values for dedicated tenants; Carla wires dashboard using PR template; Dave finalizes alert thresholds and paging rules. target: demo in 2 weeks. blockers?

dave (SRE): one small blocker — need a mapping table for pool->oncall owner for paging. please add `oncall_owner` metadata label or a small mapping service.

carla (Console): will add a link in dashboard header to pool owner if metadata present.

ben (Runtime Eng): noted — adding `pool_owner` label to metadata export. will coordinate with infra to avoid secrets leak.

alice (Platform PM): perfect. follow-up sync Thu 10am. if anyone wants to sketch visual mockups ping @carla. :thumbsup:
